items.title: Phil Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 27, 2023
items.q: And my wife Pat is a pianist from Indiana

ctx.x: What finally prompted you to consider leaving that life and entering what was very early jazz academia?

Right. Right you are. I wanted to raise a family. I mean I am the boy who came from academia in the first place. I never left academia. So that in a sense was always comfortable for me. I was always — I love people, period. I wanted to raise a family and make a living as a jazz trombone player and thanks to “Lonesome Old Town” I had a reputation all over the world. And I never got a degree myself, much to the discernment of my father, but I did get some honorary degrees a little later in life. So that made — the…
